final: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) as customer_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), overall_total AS (SELECT SUM(customer_total) as grand_total FROM customer_totals), customer_shares AS (SELECT CustomerId, customer_total, customer_total / (SELECT grand_total FROM overall_total) as share FROM customer_totals), average_share_val AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM customer_shares), above_average AS (SELECT customer_total, share FROM customer_shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share_val)) SELECT AVG(customer_total) as avg_total_spent, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share_val)) as avg_difference FROM above_average
